statement: Project Jupiter faces permitting and power delays, including an Energy Transfer pipeline permit pushed to February 1, 2027, nearly six months behind schedule, and a November 23 air-quality permit deadline.
why: Power and permitting, not chips, are increasingly the binding constraint on when new AI capacity can actually run.

impact.mechanism: Permit slippage on gas supply and air quality stretches the time between an accelerator order and energized capacity, lengthening effective delivery timelines across the build.

evidence.excerpt: faces delays including an Energy Transfer pipeline permit delay pushed to February 1, 2027 (nearly six months behind schedule) and an air-quality permit deadline of November 23

confidence.basis: Secondary wire reporting; no lead-time figure in weeks is stated, so only direction is supported.

entity: Oracle; Blue Owl Capital (developer unit); Project Jupiter (New Mexico Stargate AI data center campus); OpenAI; SoftBank
